Returning for my second year on Hack Western as a Design and Marketing lead, I am excited to announce that our hacker applications for Hack Western 11 have just opened! Collaborating with my marketing and design team on our branding this year, we present to you a theme based on the journey of travelling– letting your ideas flight ✈️ and having the space to explore them far and wide with no boundaries. Apply by Monday, October 14th, 11:59 PM EST here: https://lnkd.in/eqMkqx4R
